snippet.title: Gripex
snippet.description:
Welcome to the official YouTube channel of Jesper "Gripex" Terkildsen, aka Lee Sin God. The most recognized Lee Sin player to date who is making insane, clean, montage worthy Lee Sin plays on a regular basis, earning him the name 'Godfather of Lee Sin' in League of Legends community. Come in and learn how to play Lee Sin from the best or just enjoy some sick Lee Sin plays by the cup of RedBull :)

My Social Media:
https://twitter.com/GripexJ
https://www.facebook.com/Gripex90

Editor's Social Media :)
https://twitter.com/JKHighLight
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaGE2JOeHSXJmR6Uw4Ro0zA

Business inquiries: GripexBusiness@gmail.com

Please refrain from re-uploading highlights/vods from Gripex' twitch channel. If you want to use footage from the stream, please send permission requests to JK HighLight. We will only accept requests that meet our bare-minimum creative work requirements.
